item.title: AIM movers: Strip Tinning grant award and Thruvision Asian airport contract
item.summary: Automotive connection systems supplier Strip Tinning (LON: STG) has been awarded a DRIVE35 grant of £3m from Innovate UK and the Advanced Propulsion Centre UK to help to scale up its manufacturing and develop the cell contacting system technology. This will fund the business beyond 2027. The share price jumped 62.2% to 36.5p.
